reviews.text:
I paid $1 for a short trial in the app.
A few days later, I was charged $39 and $29.99 without clear notice of a recurring subscription or additional purchases.
I canceled the subscription immediately, but the company did not refund the money.
The experience was confusing and not transparent.

I hope the company improves transparency for future users.
